ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle A=70^\circ$, $\angle ABD=\angle BCE=30^\circ$, and $CE$ bisects $\angle ACB$. What is the measure of $\angle BEC$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $CE$ bisects $\angle ACB$,\\
hence $\angle ACE = \angle BCE = 30^\circ$,\\
since $\angle A = 70^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle ABC + \angle ACB = 110^\circ$,\\
given $\angle ABE = \angle ACE = 30^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle EBC + \angle ECB = 110^\circ - 60^\circ = 50^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle BEC = 180^\circ - 50^\circ = \boxed{130^\circ}$,
